definitions.explanation: The two-fingers-extended hand shape in the game janken, which beats paper (パー) and loses to rock (グー). The shape resembles a pair of scissors.

examples.japanese: チョキはパーに{勝|か}つ。
{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}るとき、{指|ゆび}でチョキを{作|つく}ってポーズした。
examples.english: When taking the photo, I made a scissors shape with my fingers and posed.

notes:
One of the three hand shapes in じゃんけん (rock-paper-scissors), together with グー (rock) and パー (paper). チョキ extends two fingers; it beats パー and loses to グー. The same shape doubles as the "peace sign" in photos.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チョキを{出|だ}す: to throw scissors
- {指|ゆび}でチョキを{作|つく}る: to make a scissors shape with the fingers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- グー: rock — the clenched-fist shape
- パー: paper — the open-hand shape
